steps: Create a new component and bind it to the target object before entering play mode.
Declare the observable state and record its initial value before any callback executes.
Add the initialization callback and log the exact state that the callback receives.
Add the start callback and verify that it runs only after initialization has completed.
Add the frame callback and record both the frame index and the current observable state.
Attach the component to the object and confirm that the editor reports no missing reference.
Enter play mode and preserve the first complete sequence shown in the console.
Compare the observed sequence with the declared callback contract and note every difference.
Stop play mode, correct any mismatch, and repeat the run with the same initial conditions.
Record the final pass condition together with the evidence needed for another learner to verify it.
